title: Pan-Seared Fish with English Mash
description: A simple and delicious recipe for pan-seared fish served with a side of creamy English mash.

ingredients.name: fish fillet
ingredients.notes: Choose a white fish like cod or haddock

ingredients.name: juicy
ingredients.notes: Optional, e.g. fresh parsley or lemon

instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the English mash according to package instructions.
Season the fish fillet with salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add a small amount of butter.
Place the fish fillet in the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Serve the pan-seared fish with a side of English mash.
Garnish with fresh parsley or lemon, if desired.
